events.headline: Oil posts sharpest one-day drop in three months (Mon Nov 2): Brent fell 7.6% to $104.77/bbl, WTI fell 7.3% to $96.46/bbl, on a string of Iran headlines raising hopes the conflict ends without further escalation

Nasdaq Composite fell into technical correction territory Tue Nov 3 as AI-capex doubts resurfaced; Marvell dropped ~12% on reported $221B all-stock talks to acquire Lumentum, Oracle fell ~8% on plans to raise $10B in stock and $10B in bonds to fund AI spending

Dow rose ~0.41% Tue Nov 3 even as S&P 500 (-0.51%) and Nasdaq (-1.07%) fell, as investors rotated into industrial, financial and value stocks away from large-cap AI/tech names ahead of US midterm election results
Apple shares slipped after fiscal Q4 earnings as iPhone sales beat but Greater China revenue missed estimates, adding to tech-sector weakness
